legal.pageSubtitle: Transparency and security are at the heart of Truvamate. This policy explains how we handle your data and the legal agreements for using our services.
legal.s1Intro: Truvamate Marketplace ("we") values your privacy. We collect and use personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) to provide you with the best service.
legal.s1DataDesc: Name, address, email, phone number, and payment information when you place an order.
legal.s1UsageDesc: To process orders, deliver products, and notify order status, including Lotto prize notifications.
legal.s1SecurityDesc: Credit card and financial transaction data is encrypted with international SSL standards. We do not store credit card numbers on our servers.
legal.s1SharingDesc: We may share your address with logistics partners for product delivery only.
legal.s2Intro: By using the Truvamate website, you agree to the following terms:
legal.s2_1Desc: All products are 100% authentic imports from the USA. Delivery times may vary depending on international shipping conditions. If products are damaged or counterfeit, we offer a full refund within 7 days.
legal.s2_2Desc: Truvamate is solely a "purchasing agent" (Messenger Service). We are not a direct distributor or manager of special products.
s2_2Items: Buyers must be at least 20 years old.
Proof of purchase will be stored in a safe deposit box in the United States.
We will coordinate delivery according to the agreed terms.
legal.s3Intro: Truvamate's operations are subject to Thai law and international trade regulations.
legal.s3Prohibited: Prohibited Items: We do not accept orders for or import illegal goods, drugs, weapons, or any copyright-infringing products. If found, we will cancel the order and suspend the account immediately without prior notice.
legal.s4Intro: If you have questions about the privacy policy or wish to delete your user account data, please contact our officer at:

howToUse.pageSubtitle: The easiest and safest platform for shopping American products and special product purchasing services. Get started in 4 simple steps.

marketplace.step1Desc: Browse brand-name products from the USA through various categories or use the search bar to find what you need.
marketplace.step2Desc: Check product details, prices, and reviews, then click "Add to Cart" or "Buy Now".
marketplace.step3Desc: Choose your preferred payment method (credit card, bank transfer, TrueMoney) through our 100% secure system.
marketplace.step4Desc: Products will be shipped from the USA to your doorstep (7-14 days for Air Freight) with a Tracking Number.

lotto.step1Desc: Choose to play Powerball or Mega Millions based on the Jackpot value you want.
lotto.step2Desc: Choose your own lucky numbers or use the Quick Pick system to have numbers randomly generated.
lotto.step3Desc: Pay the purchasing service fee (Powerball $5/ticket, Mega Millions $11/ticket). We will purchase the special products at authorized dealers in the USA.
lotto.step4Desc: Staff will scan proof of purchase into the system. You can view proof images in the "My Products" menu before the draw date.

howToUse.ctaDesc: Register today to receive special privileges and track your order status instantly.
howToUse.faq1A: Every product on Truvamate is imported from authorized dealers and official shops in the USA. 100% authentic guaranteed. If counterfeit products are found, we offer a full refund.
howToUse.faq2A: For small prizes, the amount will be transferred to your Truvamate account immediately. For large prizes (Jackpot), our team will arrange your trip to claim the prize in the USA or process it on your behalf with a power of attorney (fees apply as agreed).
howToUse.faq3A: Most products are shipped via Air Freight and take approximately 7-14 business days after leaving the USA warehouse.
